This webpack-style public-path runtime template reads document.currentScript.src without verifying that currentScript is a SCRIPT element. A named DOM element can clobber currentScript and supply an attacker-controlled script URL.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
metadata.applicability: JavaScript runtime templates that emit the unguarded document.currentScript-to-scriptUrl assignment used by auto public path resolution.
metadata.negative_boundary: Templates with the documented SCRIPT tag-name guard do not match. General currentScript uses and unrelated URL assignment patterns are outside this rule.

extra.message: Transitioning the CSS height property requires layout work on animation frames. Prefer a compositor-friendly transform or opacity transition when the visual behavior permits it.

metadata.applicability: Explicit transition or transition-property declarations that name the layout-affecting height property in CSS source.
metadata.negative_boundary: Transform, opacity, width, max-height, min-height, and transition: all declarations are not matched; this is a static costly-pattern finding, not a measured timing claim.
